components.name: Claude Code
components.author: Anthropic
components.description: SBOM maintained by hand; dev/cpr_precheck.py verifies it against the installed tools and the vulnerability databases before every commit.

component.name: PUG Tools
component.description: QGIS plugin (pure Python, no compiled code) that creates and validates Romanian PUG/PUZ/PUD/PATJ/PMUD GeoPackage projects. Version taken from metadata.txt.

properties.name: sbom:scope
properties.value: runtime dependencies, bundled data assets, external services, build/test/dev tooling (scope=excluded, property sbom:role=tooling)

properties.name: sbom:maintenance
properties.value: Update when metadata.txt, a bundled asset, a network endpoint or the tool set changes. Run: py -3.15 dev/cpr_precheck.py

components.name: QGIS (3.x LTR, Qt5)
components.description: Host application for Qt5 users (plugin minimum: 3.28). Provides qgis.core, qgis.gui and qgis.PyQt. Not bundled; supplied by the user's installation. Also the Qt5 test host.

components.name: QGIS (4.x, Qt6)
components.description: Host application for Qt6 users. Also the Qt6 test host.

components.name: PyQt5 (via qgis.PyQt)
components.description: Imported only via qgis.PyQt.* (QtCore, QtGui, QtWidgets, QtNetwork). Ships with QGIS 3.x (Qt 5.15.13).

components.name: PyQt6 (via qgis.PyQt)
components.description: Imported only via qgis.PyQt.*. Ships with QGIS 4.x (Qt 6.11.0).

components.name: GDAL/OGR Python bindings (osgeo.ogr, osgeo.osr)
components.description: Used for GeoPackage reads, geometry tests (rules 24-34), DeleteLayer and field-type inspection. Ships with QGIS; plugin does not pin a version.

components.name: CPython (standard library only)
components.description: The Python embedded in QGIS (verified on both test installs). Standard-library modules used: configparser, contextlib, csv, dataclasses, datetime, json, locale, math, os, re, shutil, sqlite3, traceback, typing, unicodedata, urllib.parse, uuid, zipfile. No third-party pip packages (no numpy, shapely, requests, geopandas).

components.name: SQLite (via Python sqlite3 and GDAL)
components.description: Direct SQL on the GeoPackage for reference-table copy, schema migration and metadata. The stdlib sqlite3 module lacks the GeoPackage spatial SQL functions (ST_IsEmpty etc.), so any UPDATE on a spatial table must go through GDAL.

components.name: JUD_UAT_SIRUTA_PUG_AAAALLZZ.gpkg (bundled project template)
components.description: templates/JUD_UAT_SIRUTA_PUG_AAAALLZZ/0_Seturi_date_spatiale/. Schema 3.1.0 (sys__versiune 3.1.0 / 2026-10-30). Derived from the official OMDLPA / Ministerul Dezvoltarii public template pug_3.1.0.gpkg (datelocale.mdlpa.ro, validation package 2026.10.30), with local additions: layer_styles, ~REF_* reference tables, NOT NULL constraints, and one extra _subtip_rte row ('Conducta de aductiune').

components.name: Template folders and PDFs (1_Studii_fundamentare .. 4_Avize_acorduri)
components.description: 56 PDF/placeholder files under templates/JUD_UAT_SIRUTA_PUG_AAAALLZZ/ copied into new projects; structure follows OMDLPA Order 904.

components.name: 7-Zip
components.description: Builds the distributable PUGTools-X.Y.Z.Z.zip (no build script in the repository). The zip must exclude .git, .gitignore, .idea, .claude, __pycache__, .local_resources, dev.

components.name: GitHub CLI (gh)
components.description: Tagging and 'gh release create'. Installed system-wide.

components.name: OSV-Scanner
components.description: Vulnerability scan of this SBOM (dev/cpr_precheck.py). Installed per user via winget.

components.name: CPython (system, dev scripts only)
components.description: Runs dev/cpr_precheck.py (stdlib only; launch with `py -3.15`). Not used by the plugin at runtime - QGIS embeds its own Python.

services.name: Administrative boundaries WFS (geo-spatial.org GeoServer)
services.description: Queried at runtime (tools/uat_boundary.py, via QgsBlockingNetworkRequest) with a SIRUTA code to fetch the UAT boundary; the result is cached locally and written to ~REF_UAT. Only the SIRUTA code is sent.

services.name: datelocale.mdlpa.ro published validation rules and templates
services.description: Not contacted at runtime. Reference for rule definitions (R10-R34) and template releases used during development.
